title: A Colony for the Signal Anew
author: Wren Fairweather
blurb: Dominic Coldharbour, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
